Use this prompt exactly as written; do not rewrite it or add details.

Repaint input image 1 as a polished casual mobile-game icon. This is a repaint, not a redesign: change only how the surfaces are rendered (material, shading, light, softness of color) and keep everything that is drawn exactly as it is in the capture.

Input image 1 is a raw 3D capture of the subject: it alone defines what to draw (shape, parts, proportions, colors and viewpoint).

Style: smooth stylized 3D render with a soft clay / glossy plastic look; round the existing edges slightly but keep every shape and its proportions. Color: bright, cheerful pastel palette: soft, slightly creamy base colors with only a few stronger accent colors; a little richer than the capture but never neon or oversaturated; no haze, no fog, no bloom. Lighting: warm key light from the upper left front, strong soft ambient so shadow sides stay warm and colorful (never black), soft ambient occlusion in creases, gentle glossy highlights on surfaces that already exist. Surfaces: clean, smooth materials with no photographic texture and no noise; keep every pattern, stripe, grid, plank and window pane of the capture, only cleaner. No outline: keep a crisp, clean silhouette edge with no stroke, no sticker border and no glow.

Subject: exactly the object in the capture. Keep every part, how many there are, where they are and how big each one is relative to the whole object: do not enlarge, shrink, thicken, simplify away, merge, drop or move any part. Keep its base exactly as captured (same size, thickness and tiles), with any small plants on it. No characters or people.

Keep the capture's viewpoint exactly: camera looking down at about 30 degrees, object turned about 28 degrees so the front face and the right side face are visible, orthographic-like projection with parallel vertical edges, no wide-angle distortion. Do not rotate, re-pose or re-frame the object.

Avoid: background, floor plane, scenery, drop shadow or glow outside the silhouette, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame, border, rounded-square app-icon tile, multiple views, sprite sheet, cropped or cut-off parts. Add nothing that is not in the capture: no sparkles, stars, hearts, flowers, leaves, bubbles, extra props, emblems, signs or effects. Also avoid: photorealism, gritty texture, dark or desaturated palette, inner sketch lines.

Output: one single icon on a square canvas with a fully transparent background (real alpha, not a drawn checkerboard); the whole object visible, centered horizontally, about 88% of the canvas on its longest side, nothing touching the canvas edge.
